name: A10-0278/2026 – Nathalie Loiseau – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on relations between the European Union and Syria after the fall of the Assad regime. It welcomes the reopening of political ties and the lifting of economic sanctions, but says EU money and support must depend on real progress: an inclusive political transition, free elections, protection of minorities and women, and justice for past crimes. It also calls for a long-term EU strategy on Syria with clear conditions and regular checks.

- Parliament asks for a long-term EU strategy on Syria, with support tied to progress and reviewed at least yearly.
- It affects Syria's transitional authorities, Syrian citizens and refugees, and EU taxpayers funding aid.
- Next, the EU Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests; the report itself changes no law.
